recently registered with Pastures Way Surgery in July, and I just wanted to share my experience. Every interaction I’ve had — whether with Dr. Shah, Dr. Shah (yes, there are two! 😊), Roshni the pharmacist, Violet, and all of the reception staff — has been exceptional. They genuinely go above and beyond. I can now even tell the difference between the doctors’ voices when they call, and each time, their respect and care for their patients truly stand out.

Before joining this practice, I had been with the same surgery since birth and often struggled to get the care I needed. Joining Pastures Way Surgery has truly been a blessing. Their compassion, care, and human touch have literally changed my life for the better, and I will be forever grateful for their help and support.

Each time I’ve needed assistance, they’ve listened and taken action. The online booking system and app are also incredibly easy to use, and every request is followed up promptly.

This is such a lovely practice, and I’d like to remind everyone to be kind and to share positive feedback — it really does make a difference. I can only imagine how challenging and fast-paced their environment must be, yet every team member remains caring, professional, and patient.

Thank you so much to every member of Pastures Way Surgery. I am forever grateful.
– Rachel
